title: Planning surfaces use the canon names: Planning, the owner by name, Crew tasks, and a Calendar menu line that says it holds Plans and to-dos

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25: /admin/work labels the middle stage 'Plan' (NAMING: Planning); the Plan pop-up reads 'Assigned teammate' and '<kind> production record'; /admin/crew-tasks is titled 'Crew Tasks' while the menu and /lead say 'Crew tasks'; the Space Calendar module line says 'Your events on a calendar, create a new one, and share a subscribe link' with no word for Plans or to-dos, so nobody finds Plans from the menu.

SEEN 2026-11-25 on prod: the calendar rail has its own heading 'Inbox' (undated items to drop on a day) while /inbox is the member Inbox; the rail one needs another word (for example 'Not scheduled').

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
